title: Motion Trail Ghost Visualizer with Time Control
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) that implements a Motion Trail Ghost Visualizer with full time control. The scene should work as follows:

## Scene Setup
- Dark background (color 0x0a0a1a) with a perspective camera at position (0, 5, 12) looking at the origin.
- Add ambient light (0x334466, intensity 0.4) and a directional light (0xffffff, intensity 0.8) at position (5, 10, 5).
- Add a ground plane (30x30, color 0x1a1a2e, semi-transparent alpha 0.3) at y=0.
- Add a grid helper (30 divisions, color 0x2a2a4e) on the ground plane.

## Primary Animated Object
- Create a main object: a sphere (radius 0.5, color 0x00ffaa, emissive 0x004433) that follows a 3D Lissajous curve path.
- The Lissajous parameters: x = 4*sin(2*t), y = 1.5 + 1.5*sin(3*t + PI/4), z = 3*sin(5*t).
- The object should leave ghost trails behind it as it moves.

## Ghost Trail System
- Maintain an array of ghost meshes (semi-transparent clones of the main sphere).
- Every 0.05 seconds of animation time, spawn a new ghost at the current position of the main object.
- Each ghost should have a lifetime of 2.0 seconds, during which its opacity fades from 0.6 to 0.0 linearly.
- Each ghost should also scale down from 1.0 to 0.3 over its lifetime.
- Ghosts should be colored with a gradient based on their age: newest ghosts are 0x00ffaa, oldest ghosts shift toward 0x ff44aa (interpolate HSL hue from 160 to 330 degrees).
- Maximum 40 active ghosts at any time. Remove oldest when limit is reached.
- Track total ghosts ever spawned.

## Time Control System
- Implement a time scale system with values: 0 (paused), 0.25 (slow-mo), 0.5 (half), 1.0 (normal), 2.0 (fast), 4.0 (ultra-fast).
- Keyboard controls:
  - Space: toggle pause (set timeScale to 0, or restore previous timeScale)
  - ArrowUp: increase timeScale to next step
  - ArrowDown: decrease timeScale to previous step
  - 'R' key: reset animation (clear all ghosts, reset time to 0, reset object to start position)
  - 'G' key: toggle ghost trail visibility (show/hide all ghosts)
  - 'C' key: clear all current ghosts without resetting time

## Scrub Timeline (DOM)
- Add a range slider (id='timelineScrubber') at the bottom of the screen spanning 80% width, centered.
- The slider ranges from 0 to 100 representing percentage of a full animation cycle (one cycle = 2*PI in parameter t).
- When the user drags the slider, pause the animation and set the main object position to the corresponding point on the Lissajous curve. Clear ghosts when scrubbing.
- Display the current time value next to the slider (id='timeDisplay').

## HUD / UI
- Top-left HUD panel (id='hudPanel') with dark semi-transparent background showing:
  - Current timeScale (id='hudTimeScale')
  - Active ghost count (id='hudGhostCount')
  - Total ghosts spawned (id='hudTotalGhosts')
  - Ghost visibility status (id='hudGhostVisible')
  - Animation time in seconds with 2 decimal places (id='hudAnimTime')
  - FPS counter (id='hudFPS')

## State Management
- Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with these fields updated every frame:
  - timeScale: current time scale (number)
  - isPaused: boolean
  - animationTime: cumulative animation time in seconds (float)
  - activeGhosts: number of currently active ghost meshes
  - totalGhostsSpawned: total ghosts ever created (integer)
  - ghostsVisible: boolean
  - mainObjectPosition: {x, y, z} current position of main sphere
  - mainObjectOnCurve: boolean (true if position matches Lissajous formula within epsilon 0.01)
  - oldestGhostOpacity: opacity of the oldest active ghost (number, or null if no ghosts)
  - newestGhostOpacity: opacity of the newest active ghost (number, or null if no ghosts)
  - newestGhostScale: scale of the newest ghost (number, or null if no ghosts)
  - scrubberValue: current slider value (0-100)
  - cycleProgress: percentage through current animation cycle (0-100)

## OrbitControls
- Add OrbitControls for camera interaction, importing from Three.js CDN addons.
physics_constraints: Lissajous curve: x=4*sin(2*t), y=1.5+1.5*sin(3*t+PI/4), z=3*sin(5*t). Ghost opacity decays linearly from 0.6 to 0.0 over 2 seconds. Ghost scale decays from 1.0 to 0.3 over 2 seconds. Maximum 40 active ghosts. All position values must be NaN-free. Time must be monotonically non-decreasing when not paused/reset. Ghost count must never exceed 40.
